text.en: Pet owners consistently praise Amanda for her warm, considerate personality and professional dedication. Reviewers appreciate that she takes time to consult with owners about styling preferences, offers helpful puppy care advice, and treats every visiting dog as an individual rather than just another scheduled appointment.

Clients are delighted with the standard of grooming, noting that dogs return home with neat, beautiful haircuts and fresh-smelling coats. Whether styling bichons, Irish doodles, or young maltipoos, reviewers highlight Amanda's meticulous attention to detail and clear communication if adjustments to coat length are needed.

Reviewers highlight Amanda's natural ability to put sensitive, nervous, or first-time pets at ease in a calm setting. Dog owners note that even timid chihuahuas and young puppies remain calm throughout their appointments, leaving the Southgate Road studio relaxed and looking their best.

q.en: Does Silver Bark Grooming accommodate nervous or timid dogs?

a.en: Yes, clients emphasize that Amanda handles nervous and fussy dogs with exceptional patience and quiet reassurance.

q.en: Are introductory grooming sessions available for puppies?

a.en: Yes, the groomer welcomes young puppies for introductory sessions and provides practical advice for first-time owners.

q.en: What grooming treatments are offered at the studio?

a.en: Services include complete styling haircuts, warm hydrobath washes, gentle blow-dries, and coat de-matting.

q.en: Where is Silver Bark Grooming located?

a.en: The private grooming studio is located on Southgate Road in Islington, North London.
